Test case Objective: Verify stats cards and class performance line chart render correctly at page load
Steps:
1. Log in as a Class Coordinator.
2. Navigate to Dashboard.
3. Inspect statistical counters and the performance trend chart.
Expected Result: Dashboard loads; statistics counter animations complete; average performance line chart displays correctly.

Scenario objective: Verify Search Student Progress by Name
Test case Objective: Verify search filter dynamically filters the list of students by name
Steps:
1. Go to Student Progress page.
2. Type a student name in the search input.
3. Verify filtered student list.
Expected Result: Only student records matching the name "Rahul" (e.g., Rahul Verma) are shown in the table.

Test case Objective: Filter students based on performance status range
Steps:
1. Go to Student Progress page.
2. Select "Excellent (> 75%)" from the Performance Range dropdown.
3. Verify the filtered list.
Expected Result: The list updates to display only students with average marks greater than 75%.

Scenario objective: Verify Student Profile Modal Tabs Navigation
Test case Objective: Ensure student details modal opens and displays subject/activity/attendance data across tabs
Steps:
1. Go to Student Progress.
2. Click Action / View for a student.
3. Click through the tabs: Subject-wise Marks, Activity-wise Details, and Subject-wise Attendance.
Test Data: Click action on a student record (e.g., Rahul Verma)
Expected Result: Modal opens; tabs switch successfully and display respective detailed table entries.

Test case Objective: Check if switching reports updates the preview document paper dynamically
Steps:
1. Go to Academic Reports page.
2. Click on the Student Performance Report card.
3. Observe preview panel title and content.
Expected Result: Preview title updates to "Report Preview: Student Performance" and list displays student metrics.

Test case Objective: Verify the "Download PDF" functionality triggers file download
Steps:
1. Go to Academic Reports.
2. Click the Download PDF button in the preview header.
Expected Result: Browser initiates download of the PDF report file containing the current report preview data.

Test case Objective: Check that dashboard warns user of unread messages from HOD
Steps:
1. Ensure the database contains unread HOD messages for the coordinator's department.
2. Login to Coordinator Dashboard.
3. Observe top alert banner.
Test Data: Active session for Coordinator with department id
Expected Result: A warning card is displayed at the top indicating unread HOD messages with a button to view them.

Test case Objective: Ensure unauthorized users cannot access restricted coordinator pages
Steps:
1. Open an incognito browser window or log out.
2. Attempt to directly enter URL http://localhost:8000/coordinator/reports.php.
Expected Result: Direct access is blocked; system redirects user to the login page (login.php).

Test case Objective: Ensure password update fails when new and confirm passwords do not match
Steps:
1. Go to My Profile page.
2. Fill Change Password form with valid current password.
3. Enter mismatched new and confirm passwords.
4. Submit the form.
Expected Result: Passwords mismatch; validation warning displays, and password update is prevented.

Test case Objective: Ensure searching with invalid/non-existent queries returns empty state gracefully
Steps:
1. Go to Student Progress page.
2. Type non-existent keywords or special symbols in search box.
3. Verify student list and badge.
Expected Result: Table displays a friendly "No students found" message, and the count badge shows "Showing 0 students".
